sections.title: Tools and accounts
sections.help: Tick what already exists for this site. Anything left unticked goes into month 1 of the plan as a create-and-connect task.

items.label: Google Search Console
items.task: Create and verify the Search Console domain property, submit the XML sitemap, and grant access to the team

items.label: Google Analytics 4
items.task: Create the GA4 property, install the tag on every template, and link it to Search Console

items.label: Google Tag Manager
items.task: Create the GTM container, install it sitewide, and move existing tags into it

items.label: Conversion tracking (forms, calls, sales)
items.task: Define the key conversions and track them as GA4 key events through GTM

items.label: Bing Webmaster Tools
items.task: Verify the site in Bing Webmaster Tools (import from Search Console) and submit the sitemap

items.label: Google Business Profile
items.task: Create or claim the Google Business Profile for each location and complete verification

items.label: Google Merchant Center
items.task: Create the Merchant Center account, verify the site and submit the product feed

items.label: CMS access for the SEO team
items.task: Get editor/admin access to the CMS for the SEO team

items.label: Developer available for technical changes
items.task: Agree who implements technical fixes and the turnaround time

ecommerce: Traffic to product and category pages

fields.label: Main products or services (one per line)

sections.title: Languages
sections.help: The whole site is always crawled. Language versions are detected automatically from the URLs (for example /ar). Add rows only if you want to set them yourself: one row per language with its URL prefix, / for the language at the root.
